Like so many I started with sourdough, threw it away, shed a few tears (postpartum hormones😅), went down a sourdough rabbit hole, got overwhelmed, almost quit again, took a class, and then produced an edible loaf and was hooked 👏

But with two little boys and a busy lifestyle I needed to find a way to make sourdough work for me (not the other way around). So I started experimenting, skipping steps, speeding up the timeline which eventually led me to the recipe and method I’ve been using and teaching for years 🤗 

And when I realized how many people out there wanted quick & easy same day sourdough recipes I started making more and which eventually led me to creating this book and seeing it in so many of your homes is the best thing ever 🥹

So whether you want the book or are just looking to follow along for quick and easy sourdough recipes for free on my blog (I have over 150!!), welcome ❤️

#samedaysourdough #sourdoughrecipes #sourdough #fromscratch #bakingbread

To celebrate the final season of Stranger Things 👹 @Netflix @Stranger Things 

My kids challenged me to bake a Demogorgon… so I did.

500g flour, 250g starter, 360g water, 10g salt.
Knead. Divide. Color. Rest overnight.
Bake at 500°F - 15 min with steam, 20 without.

When I opened the oven… it was alive. 👹🔥

Turns out I have strong opinions about starter jars. 😅

Comment “JAR” and I’ll DM you the link to my favorite starter jar. 

I used mason jars for my starter for YEARS, and honestly, they worked just fine. You absolutely do not need a special jar to make sourdough. But then I started using this one, and I don’t want to go back.

Here’s why I love it:

* The size - I know you can keep a small amount of starter, but I bake a lot, and this holds the amount I actually like to keep on hand for my weekly baking.
* The silicone lid - probably my favorite feature. It’s so easy to take on and off.
* The shape - the sides flare outward toward the top, which makes it really easy to get in there to mix, feed, and scrape down the jar.
* The markings - I can easily see how much starter I have and how much it’s grown.
* Made by bakers for bakers - the little details are really well thought out because it was designed specifically for sourdough bakers.

And it’s on sale for Prime Day this week! Comment JAR and I’ll DM you the link plus all of my Prime Day deals!
